<?php

$deck = [];
foreach (str_split('SHDC') as $suit) {
    foreach (str_split('A23456789TJQK') as $rank) {
        $deck[] = $rank . $suit;
    }
}
$state = 2026;
for ($i = 51; $i >= 1; $i--) {
    $state = ($state * 48271) % 2147483647;
    $j = $state % ($i + 1);
    [$deck[$i], $deck[$j]] = [$deck[$j], $deck[$i]];
}
foreach (array_chunk($deck, 13) as $row) {
    echo implode(' ', $row), "\n";
}
